status: dated clarification; the 2026-08-25 measurement is unchanged
retention: The dated evidence file is retained unchanged. This erratum is the correction of record.

corrections.issue: The comparison used a retired AccessMap test count (1,680).
corrections.correction: The 1,680 figure was a retired AccessMap count and was not AccessMap's count on 2026-08-25. AccessMap's dated count at 2026-08-16 was 2,971 tests across 204 suites, published with its method on /work/flagstone/. The portfolio's 763 tests in this receipt are unaffected.

corrections.issue: The summary says 'every tab stop' while the method describes a keyboard-traced sample.
corrections.correction: The 2026-08-25 focus check was a keyboard-traced sample. The 100% figure describes the sampled tab stops, not a full census; the page now says 'sampled tab stops, keyboard-traced'.
